key_insight: RheOPT transfers geometry-conditioned transport structure from Newtonian simulations to improve few-shot non-Newtonian flow prediction.
engineering_relevance: Pretraining on inexpensive Newtonian simulations can reduce the costly non-Newtonian training data needed for flow surrogates.
method: Pretrain a transformer-based neural operator on Newtonian flow simulations.
Fine-tune on a few non-Newtonian samples in matched geometries.
Evaluate normalization sensitivity and use phase-insensitive diagnostics for oscillatory wakes.
evidence_signal: Across contraction and triangular-obstacle wake tests, four-sample fine-tuning could match or exceed 16-sample scratch training in the contraction, while pretraining recovered wake shedding frequency and fluctuation amplitude suppressed by few-shot scratch training.
watch_item: Transfer was evaluated in geometry-matched settings, and its benefit depended on normalization: reliable with RevIN but dataset dependent with Global normalization.
paper_title: RheOPT: Few-Shot Non-Newtonian Flow Prediction via Newtonian Pretraining of RheOFormer
